glossary.definition: The accepted reference behavior or output that the candidate change must be compared against.
A small fixed check that protects an important behavior across baseline and candidate results.
The chance that a change quietly weakens something the baseline already protected.
The final evidence-based choice to Release, Hold, or Iterate.
The small set of items worth watching after a change moves forward.
A change that improves one thing while weakening or obscuring another protected behavior.
